nodes.title: RECOVERY / ASSEMBLE LATER
widgets_values:
The two amber recovery nodes are MUTED by default.

If all segments finished but final assembly did not, mute the main green Assemble node, enable both recovery nodes, and queue. They validate every SHA-256 checkpoint pair and assemble without rerendering the completed clips.

For an interrupted generation, leave recovery muted and set Loop Start's start_clip to the first unfinished clip.

nodes.title: V2 LOOPING I2VA — HOW TO USE IT
widgets_values:
This is the simple one-image, no-last-frame workflow. It requests two 10-second scenes and renders them through one recursive body. H3 rounds each request up to 243 raw frames. Scene 1 delivers all 243 frames; scene 2 repeats 5 motion-context frames and Loop Trim removes them, so final delivery is 243 + 238 = 481 frames = 20.04 seconds at 24 fps.

1. Select one real opening image in PICTURE 1. The bundled filename is a placeholder.
2. The First-Scene Image Gate sends that image to core I2V only for scene 1. On scene 2 it outputs no first frame, allowing H3 Motion Context to drive the continuation. Do not bypass the gate or the opening image will be reapplied.
3. Edit both prompts in Scene Prompt Editor. Scene 1 uses the required I2VA <Picture 1> alignment line; scene 2 intentionally contains no Picture reference. Hover Picture 1 in the editor: it is active in scene 1 and visibly inactive in scene 2.
4. Keep context_length and audio_context_length at 5 for this exact 20.04-second demonstration. A 22-frame overlap would produce only 19.33 seconds from the same two requests.
5. Queue, then use Review Gate to approve, edit+retry, reroll, or stop. Final Assemble preserves generated audio and uses a date token. Existing files receive _001, _002, and so on.

To extend beyond 20 seconds, duplicate the continuation scene in Plan. Every added 10-second request contributes 238 delivered frames, about 9.92 seconds, with this 5-frame overlap.

nodes.title: H3 PLAN V2 — 2 × 10s I2VA CHAIN
CREDITS / IMPLEMENTATION
widgets_values:
Core MiniMax H3 Image-to-Video conditioning remains owned by ComfyUI. This workflow adds a small first-scene image gate plus the disk-backed Context Loop plan, continuation, checkpoint, review, recovery, and assembly stages around it.

Recursive GraphBuilder traversal is a specialized MiniMax adaptation of Ethanfel's SxCP loop implementation in ComfyUI-Prompt-Builder.

Scene 1 follows the bundled H3 I2VA prompt format: the exact 0.00-second Picture 1 instruction followed by integrated_multimodal_description, overall_soundscape, and non_diegetic_music. Scene 2 is a context-only continuation and deliberately does not reference Picture 1.

nodes.title: SCENE PROMPT EDITOR — PICTURE 1 ACTIVE ONLY IN SCENE 1
I2VA + CONTINUATION QUICK REFERENCE
widgets_values:
SCENE 1 — I2VA

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

Then write exactly these fields in order:

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Begin from Picture 1 and develop action forward.

overall_soundscape: Describe ambience and synchronized physical sounds.

non_diegetic_music: Describe audience-only music, or N/A.

SCENE 2+ — MOTION-CONTEXT CONTINUATION

Do not mention Picture 1: the gate has removed it. Start directly with integrated_multimodal_description and explicitly continue the incoming action, pose, camera motion, lighting, and object states without resetting them. Keep the three fields in the same order.

TIMING

Two requested 10-second scenes normalize to 243 raw frames each. With head context 5, delivery is 243 + (243 - 5) = 481 frames = 20.04 seconds at 24 fps.

nodes.title: CURRENT SCENE — I2VA FIRST / CONTINUATION AFTER
CORE I2VA SCENE 1 — T2VA ON CONTINUATIONS
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, begin from the exact subject identity, clothing, environment, lighting, camera angle, framing, pose, object placement, and spatial relationships established by <Picture 1>. Build one uninterrupted shot with no cut. The camera begins a smooth tracking move at a measured speed as the principal subject initiates a clear forward action appropriate to the opening image. Preserve anatomy, materials, scale, contact points, screen direction, and lighting continuity while the movement develops naturally. During the final seconds, keep both the subject's action and the camera movement visibly in progress so the next generated scene can continue them without a reset. Replace this generic action with motion suited to your selected opening image before rendering.

overall_soundscape: Continuous environmental ambience appropriate to the opening image, with synchronized footsteps, fabric movement, handled-object sounds, and spatial reflections matching the visible action. Keep the ambience and active sounds in progress at the boundary.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
